markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 这四个词都在说**「有多……」**。too 是**太过了**，有问题；enough 是**刚好够**；so 和 such 是**非常**，后面常跟 that 说结果。

uses.en: This laptop is [[too]] slow for Xcode.
uses.en_zh: 这台电脑跑 Xcode 太慢了。

uses.en: Is the room big [[enough]] for ten people?
uses.en_zh: 这个房间够坐十个人吗？

uses.en: The talk was [[so]] good that I watched it twice.
uses.en_zh: 那个演讲太好了，我看了两遍。

too.title: too：太……了
too.rule: too 说的是**超过了，出问题了**，常带着「所以做不了」的意思。too big to email = 太大了，没法发邮件。

examples.en: The file is [[too]] big to email.
examples.zh: 文件太大了，没法用邮件发。

examples.en: It's [[too]] late to change the design now.
examples.zh: 现在改设计已经太晚了。

examples.en: This jacket is [[too]] small for me.

wrong.bad: This app is ~~too~~ useful, I love it!
wrong.good: This app is [[really]] useful, I love it!

notes: 名词前面：[[too many]] + 能数的（too many meetings），[[too much]] + 不能数的（too much work）。

enough.title: enough：够
enough.rule: enough 放哪儿很重要：**形容词后面，名词前面**。big enough（够大），enough time（够的时间）。

examples.en: Your English is good [[enough]] for the interview.
examples.zh: 你的英语应付面试够用了。

examples.en: We don't have [[enough]] time to test everything.
examples.zh: 我们没有足够的时间把所有东西都测一遍。

examples.en: He didn't run fast [[enough]] to catch the bus.
examples.zh: 他跑得不够快，没赶上公交。

so.title: so：这么、那么
so.rule: so 后面**直接跟形容词或副词**，没有名词。想说「所以怎么样了」，就在后面加 that + 一句话。

examples.en: The bug was [[so]] tricky that it took us two days.
examples.zh: 那个 bug 太难搞了，我们花了两天。

examples.en: She speaks [[so]] fast that I can't follow her.
examples.zh: 她说话太快了，我跟不上。

notes: so 也能接 many / much：There were [[so many]] bugs that we delayed the release.
口语里 that 常常省掉：It was so cold I stayed in.

such.title: such：这么一个
such.rule: such 后面**一定有名词**。单个能数的东西要加 a / an，而且 a 站在 such 后面：such a nice day。

examples.en: It was [[such]] a nice day that we ate outside.
examples.zh: 天气太好了，我们在外面吃的饭。

examples.en: We had [[such]] bad weather on holiday.
examples.zh: 我们度假时天气特别差。

this.en: The coffee is [[too]] hot to drink.

that.en: The coffee is [[very]] hot, but I can drink it.

commonMistakes.why: 后面有名词 idea，用 such a。
too 是「太过了，有问题」；高兴不是问题，用 so 或 very。

commonMistakes.bad: There's too ~~much~~ bugs in this build.
commonMistakes.good: There are [[too many]] bugs in this build.

quiz.prompt: This laptop is ___ slow to run Xcode.
quiz.explain: 慢到没法用，是「太过了」：[[too]] slow。

quiz.prompt: There are ___ many meetings this week to get any real work done.

traps.note: 后面是 to do，说「多到没法干活」，用 too many。

quiz.explain: 多到做不了事：[[too many]] … to do。

quiz.prompt: 改错：This app is too useful, I love it!
quiz.answer: This app is really useful, I love it!
accept: This app is very useful, I love it!
This app is so useful, I love it!

quiz.prompt: 改错：There's too much bugs in this build.
quiz.answer: There are too many bugs in this build.

quiz.prompt: 用 enough 改写：The room is too small for ten people.
quiz.answer: The room isn't big enough for ten people.
accept: The room is not big enough for ten people.
quiz.explain: too small = not big enough：[[big enough]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：The screen isn't enough big.
accept: The screen is not big enough.
quiz.explain: enough 放在形容词后面：[[big enough]]。

quiz.prompt: He didn't run ___ to catch the bus.
quiz.explain: 副词在前，enough 在后：[[fast enough]]。

quiz.prompt: We don't have ___ testers for this release.（够的）
The bug was ___ tricky that it took us two days to fix.

traps.note: such 后面要有名词；这里 tricky 后面直接是 that，用 so。

quiz.explain: tricky 是形容词，后面没有名词，用 [[so]]。

quiz.prompt: 用 so … that 连成一句：She speaks very fast. I can't follow her.
quiz.answer: She speaks so fast that I can't follow her.
accept: She speaks so fast I can't follow her.
She speaks so fast that I cannot follow her.

quiz.prompt: It was ___ a long meeting that I nearly fell asleep.
quiz.explain: 后面有 a long meeting，用 [[such]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：We had a such great time on holiday.
quiz.answer: We had such a great time on holiday.
quiz.explain: a 站在 such 后面：[[such a]]。
friends 是复数，不加 a：[[such]] good friends。

quiz.prompt: The coffee is ___ hot, but I can drink it.
It was ___ nice weather that we ate outside.
quiz.explain: weather 不能数，不加 a：[[such]] nice weather。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：这个文件太大了，没法用邮件发。
quiz.answer: This file is too big to email.
accept: The file is too big to email.
This file is too big to send by email.
The file is too big to send by email.
This file is too large to email.
The file is too large to email.
quiz.explain: [[too]] + 形容词 + to do = 太……没法……。

openTask.prompt: 说 3 句话，吐槽或夸夸你最近的工作：一句用 too，一句用 enough，一句用 so … that 或 such … that。
rules: enough 放在形容词后面、名词前面
so 后面接形容词 / 副词，such 后面要有名词，单数加 a
openTask.note: 规则判 too / enough / so / such 的位置和搭配（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
